newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Merchants, Seino allies in Singapore JV.
newsitem.headline: Merchants, Seino allies in Singapore JV.

text.p: Sinagpore air freight firm Merchants Air Cargo said on Friday it had formed a strategic alliance with Japan's Seino Transportation Company to help it tap into the lucrative Japanese market.
Merchants Air Cargo said in a statement the new company would be called Seino Merchants Singapore Pte Ltd (SMS).

"Japan represents the second largest air cargo market after the U.S. and is therefore very important to us," said Joseph Low, former managing director of Merchants Air Cargo and now chairman and chief executive SMS, in the statement.
Low said plans in the pipeline for SMS included moving into related areas of general and climate-controlled warehousing, distribution and route development.
"In the long run, SMS intends to develop itself into an intermodal company," Low said, adding that this included cross-border trucking between Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand.
No financial details of the deal were disclosed, but existing Merchants Air Cargo staff, global agencies and associates as well as current customers would be retained by SMS, the statement said.
